title: Contextual Causal Bayesian Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2301.12412v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a unified framework for contextual and causal Bayesian optimisation, which aims to design intervention policies maximising the expectation of a target variable. Our approach leverages both observed contextual information and known causal graph structures to guide the search. Within this framework, we propose a novel algorithm that jointly optimises over policies and the sets of variables on which these policies are defined. This thereby extends and unifies two previously distinct approaches: Causal Bayesian Optimisation and Contextual Bayesian Optimisation, while also addressing their limitations in scenarios that yield suboptimal results. We derive worst-case and instance-dependent high-probability regret bounds for our algorithm. We report experimental results across diverse environments, corroborating that our approach achieves sublinear regret and reduces sample complexity in high-dimensional settings.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个统一情境贝叶斯优化与因果贝叶斯优化的框架，旨在设计能够最大化目标变量期望的干预策略。我们的方法同时利用观测到的情境信息和已知的因果图结构来指导搜索。在该框架内，我们提出了一种新颖的算法，能够对策略以及策略所定义的变量集合进行联合优化。由此，本方法扩展并统一了此前两种相互独立的方法——因果贝叶斯优化和情境贝叶斯优化，同时也解决了它们在某些场景下产生次优结果的局限性。我们为该算法推导了最坏情况和实例相关的高概率遗憾界限。我们在多种环境下报告了实验结果，证实了我们的方法能够实现次线性遗憾，并在高维设置中降低样本复杂度。
tldr: 本文提出统一情境贝叶斯优化与因果贝叶斯优化的框架及新算法，通过联合优化干预策略及其变量集合，实现了次线性遗憾并降低了高维场景下的样本复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework and a novel algorithm for contextual causal Bayesian optimisation that jointly optimises intervention policies and their variable sets, achieving sublinear regret and reduced sample complexity in high-dimensional settings.
